title: Ziyarat of Imam Sajjad
intro: The visitation of Imam Ali Zayn al-Abidin, the fourth Imam, whose resting place is in Jannat al-Baqi.
description: Read Ziyarat of Imam Sajjad with arabic text, transliteration and english meaning, recitation context and source references.

blocks.english: Peace be on you, O leader of Those who prostrate!
Peace be on you, O prestige of Worshipping ones!
Peace be on you, O participant Of unhappiness and sadness!
Peace be on you, O the Imam, Who got sores on spots which Touched during sijda!
Peace be on you, O one who Wept and mourned!
Peace be on you, one who was Captive of hardships!

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أعْظَمَ آلِ الْعِبَاءِ
blocks.transliteration: assalaamo a’layka yaa aadama aalil e’baae
blocks.english: Peace be on you, O one from The great worshippers!

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا ابْنَ خَامِسِ أصْحَابِ أَهْلِ الْكِسَاءِ
blocks.transliteration: assalaamo a’layka yabna khaamese ahlil kesaae..
blocks.english: Peace be on you , O the son of The fifth of the people of the Cloak (Husayn)

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا ابْنَ سَيِِّدِ الشُّهَدَاءِ
blocks.english: Peace be on you, O son of the Leader of the martyrs!
Peace be on you , O support of Pious ones!

blocks.transliteration: assalaamo a’layka wa rahmatullaahe wa barakaatohu..
blocks.english: Peace be on you, and Allah’s Blessings and bounties on you!

urduGuidance: یہ صفحہ زیارت امام سجاد علیہ السلام کے لیے ہے۔ عربی متن اصل قراءت کے لیے ہے اور رومن تلفظ پڑھنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ انگریزی معنی الگ درج ہیں۔ ماخذ اور دوسری زیارات کے روابط صفحے کے آخر میں دیے گئے ہیں۔
